_comment: The source registry. Endpoints the fetch layer may reach.
NOT a tool list. Adding a source changes no toolset signature and creates
no new task type, which is why this file can grow without cost.
Nothing is excluded on scope grounds. The MCP cannot assume the scope of
its own operation, so the registry accommodates rather than pre-judges.
enabled      reachable today. false = present, documented, inert. A
credentialled source cannot be enabled in the committed file
because the credential is not here; the proxy layer holds it
and flips this at deployment.
auth         honest: NONE | API_KEY | BEARER | SERVICE_KEY | JWT | AWS_SIGV4.
constraints  markers the policy layer enforces at the point of use.
constraint vocabulary:
TIME_WITNESS    contributes a vote to the time quorum. See time_policy.
WRITE_EFFECT    has effects in the world. Requires net_call, not net_fetch,
and a contract whose purpose names it.
PII             personal data. Lawful basis and retention attach.
RATE_FRAGILE    a published limit that gets the deployment blocked if
ignored.
LICENCE_REVIEW  output carries terms that must survive into anything
derived from it.
COMPOUNDING     one request can consume many credits. Budget by credit,
not by call.
MODEL_INFERENCE hosted model access. Reachable by llm_prompt from a
PROVISIONED agent. Never a role binding: TaskMaster owns
role-to-model assignment under binding_strength, and
nothing here can rebind PSY, the Emissary, or AgentAgent.

tiers.SECURITY: Vulnerability, advisory, and reputation data. Feeds the security gate.
tiers.DISCOVERY: Registries of other services, for adapting to an external protocol.

sources.name: GitHub raw content
sources.notes: Fetch at a pinned ref. Prefer a commit SHA over a branch name.

sources.name: GitHub REST API
sources.notes: 60/hour is exhaustible in one build. A token raises it to 5000/hour.

sources.name: crates.io API
sources.notes: Rejects requests without a descriptive User-Agent.

sources.name: OSV vulnerability database
sources.notes: Queryable by package and version. Without this the security gate is checking nothing.

sources.name: deps.dev API
sources.notes: Cross-ecosystem dependency graphs, licences, advisories. Covers all five style languages from one interface.

sources.name: URLhaus
sources.notes: Keyless malicious-URL feed. Covers part of the safe-browsing job with no credential.

sources.name: Google Safe Browsing
sources.notes: URL reputation before browse. Worth a key: the browser tool is the highest-risk egress path in the manifest.

sources.name: Wikidata SPARQL
sources.notes: An unbounded SPARQL query is a self-inflicted denial of service. Queries must carry LIMIT.

sources.name: arXiv API
sources.notes: HTTPS form. The 3-second floor is published and enforced.

sources.name: Crossref REST
sources.notes: A mailto in the User-Agent moves requests to the polite pool.

sources.name: RFC Editor
sources.notes: Immutable once published, hence the long TTL.

sources.name: NCBI E-utilities
sources.notes: Gene, protein, nucleotide, OMIM, taxonomy. NCBI blocks on sustained overrun.

sources.name: UCSC Genome Browser API
sources.notes: Assemblies, sequences, annotation tracks.

sources.name: Alliance of Genome Resources
sources.notes: Cross-species gene, phenotype, disease associations.

sources.name: GDC open cancer genomics
sources.notes: Open tier only. Controlled-access GDC data requires dbGaP authorisation and is a different system.

sources.name: Public API registry
sources.notes: Serves the adapt-to-any-external-protocol principle directly. Community registries are historically flaky; treat an outage as non-blocking.

sources.name: public-apis-live search
sources.notes: Semantic search and health tracking across the registry. Confirm the host resolves and is maintained before enabling.

sources.name: Nager.Date public holidays
sources.notes: 90+ countries.

sources.name: OpenHolidays
sources.notes: Regional and school holidays.

sources.name: Open-Meteo
sources.notes: Forecast and air quality. Keyless.

sources.name: Sunrise-Sunset
sources.notes: Astronomical times derived from a date.

sources.name: WorldTimeAPI
sources.notes: One vote in the time quorum. Never authoritative alone; see time_policy.

sources.name: OpenTimeZone
sources.notes: One vote in the time quorum. Confirm the host is live at deployment.

sources.name: Met Museum collection
sources.notes: The open-access subset is CC0; the rest is not. Check isPublicDomain per object.

sources.name: Openverse search
sources.notes: Openly licensed media. Licence varies per result and must survive into any derived output.

sources.name: Frankfurter FX rates
sources.notes: ECB reference rates. Keyless, stable, no account.

sources.name: Resend transactional email
sources.notes: The 100/day cap is hard and bursts need queue smoothing. Note 05's notification ladder is a plausible consumer.

sources.name: Supabase Auth
sources.notes: The per-project host is templated; the fetch layer needs a substitution mechanism before this is reachable. 50k MAU free tier.

sources.name: Clerk
sources.notes: 50k MAU free, then per-MAU.

sources.name: WorkOS AuthKit
sources.notes: 1M MAU free tier. Enterprise SSO connections bill separately per connection.

sources.name: OpenRouter inference
sources.notes: Reachable by llm_prompt from a PROVISIONED agent whose contract names it. Not a role binding: TaskMaster owns role-to-model assignment under binding_strength.

sources.name: TimeAPI.io
sources.notes: Independent operator. One vote.

sources.name: Cloudflare trace
sources.notes: Returns an epoch in ts=. Different operator and anycast network from the rest of the pool, which is what makes it worth a vote.

sources.name: Postmark
sources.notes: 100/mo non-expiring, unlimited domains. The developer tier that does not lapse.

sources.name: Amazon SES
sources.notes: Region is templated upstream; pinned here to us-east-1 until the fetch layer supports substitution. Requires domain warmup and sandbox exit.

sources.name: AgentMail
sources.notes: Per-agent inbox identity with RFC5322 threading and inbound webhooks. The most directly useful entry in the comms tier: it gives a provisioned agent its own addressable identity, which is a capability nothing else here provides.

sources.name: MailboxValidator
sources.notes: Deliverability check. Read-only, so no WRITE_EFFECT — but an address submitted to a third party is still disclosure.

sources.name: CoinMarketCap
sources.notes: 15k credits/mo, but a multi-token or multi-fiat query consumes tens to hundreds per request. Budget by credit, not by call.

sources.name: DexScreener
sources.notes: Keyless, uncapped, real-time DEX pairs. The strongest free fallback in this tier.

_comment: Ids from the upstream manifest whose endpoint records were still truncated
when this file was written. Listed rather than invented — a fabricated
base_url is an allowlist entry pointing somewhere nobody checked. Fill each
from the upstream file, then add it with enabled:false and its constraints.
Everything recoverable from the material received so far has been imported.

import_notes.ai_*: MODEL_INFERENCE where a model is called; the transform-only ones (vectorize, background remove) are image processing and need no marker.
import_notes.ai_face_swap / ai_voice_clone / ai_lip_s: Impersonation capability. Legitimate in media production, abusable elsewhere. Import enabled:false with a documented use policy so the decision is on the record rather than implicit.
import_notes.banking_*: Financial-data obligations well beyond an allowlist entry.
import_notes.security_scan_file: Uploads a file to a third party — WRITE_EFFECT plus a data-egress review.

_comment: Reducing time sources does not reduce the attack surface, it concentrates
it. One unauthenticated timestamp is a value an attacker on the path
chooses. A quorum across independent operators, networks, and
jurisdictions is something an attacker must own in aggregate.
The cheapest witnesses are already here: every HTTPS response carries a
Date header. Thirty enabled sources is thirty independent observations at
no additional egress and no additional dependency. Dedicated time APIs
widen the pool further; they are not the foundation of it.

tiers.SIGNED: Roughtime and RFC 3161 responses over a fresh nonce. Authoritative on their own. Configured at deployment.
tiers.QUORUM: Date headers harvested from every source contacted, plus dedicated time endpoints. Authoritative in agreement, per min_witnesses and max_spread_s.
tiers.OBSERVED: A single unauthenticated reading. Display and timezone arithmetic only.

time_policy.outlier_rule: Discard readings outside max_spread_s of the median, then require min_witnesses survivors. Fewer survivors yields UNANCHORED, never a guess.
time_policy.elapsed_time: Never measured by wall clock. The monotonic TPM clock decides every interval — countdown, lease expiry, grace. Quorum time anchors what o'clock it is; it does not measure duration.
